body.name: finite input and explicit recursive task state
body.construction:
For a finite canonically encoded input \(I=(G^{+},H,A,a,Y,p_H)\), define
\[
 \operatorname{State}(I)=
 \bigl(I,\operatorname{Work},\operatorname{Factors},
       \operatorname{Ledger},\operatorname{Result}\bigr).
\]
Here \(\operatorname{Work}\) is a finite multiset whose elements are exactly
\(\operatorname{Start}\),
\(\operatorname{District}(D^{*},\mathrm{phase},C,G_C,q_C,\mathrm{contexts})\),
\(\operatorname{Fix}(G,q,T,\mathrm{continuation})\),
\(\operatorname{A2}(D^{*},C,G_C,q_C,\mathrm{remainingCandidates})\),
\(\operatorname{Factor}(D^{*},q_{D^{*}},s)\),
\(\operatorname{Join}(Y^{*},\mathrm{pendingDistricts})\), and
\(\operatorname{Residual}(\mathrm{tag},\mathrm{payload})\).  The factor store is a finite map keyed by districts.  The result is exactly one of
\(\operatorname{Running}\),
\(\operatorname{Formula}(F_H,\mathcal D_H^{\mathrm{den}},\mathfrak D_H)\),
\(\operatorname{LGSFailPos}(D^{*})\),
\(\operatorname{LGSFailThicket}(D^{*},C)\),
\(\operatorname{LGSFailHedge}(D^{*},C)\),
\(\operatorname{LGSFailA2NoCandidate}(D^{*},C)\), or
\(\operatorname{ResidualPending}(\mathrm{tag},\mathrm{payload})\).  Define \(\operatorname{init}_H(I)\) to have the singleton work multiset \(\{\!\{\operatorname{Start}\}\!\}\), empty factor store and ledger, and result \(\operatorname{Running}\).
